In third place, Maatrubhumi - Trailer | Salman Khan, Chitrangda Singh…, by Salman Khan Films, with over 18 thousand comments.
In second place, PULAU - KHW PART 402 - SUMATERA UTARA, by Nadia Omara, with over 19 thousand comments.
And number one: Aku Masih Di Sini PART 11 - Dhot Design, by Dhot Design, with over 73 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
